prompt: Draw a clean black-outlined apple with a large rounded apple body with a shallow indentation at the top, a small indentation at the bottom, a short curved stem rising upward, and one elongated leaf extending toward the upper-right. Include a few simple curved contour lines inside the apple and leaf.

steps.name: apple_body
steps.description: Draw the main outer contour of the apple as one smooth closed curved shape.

elements.placement: Large rounded apple body. The top has two rounded shoulders separated by a shallow stem indentation. The sides bulge outward and taper toward a slightly lobed bottom.

steps.name: stem
steps.description: Draw the short curved stem emerging from the top indentation of the apple.

elements.placement: Left edge of the narrow stem, beginning at the apple and curving slightly toward the upper-left.
Right edge of the stem returning from the upper tip toward the apple.

steps.name: leaf_outer_shape
steps.description: Draw the elongated leaf extending from the stem toward the upper-right.

elements.placement: Long pointed leaf attached near the stem. The leaf curves upward initially and tapers to a sharp point on the right.

steps.name: leaf_center_vein
steps.description: Draw the main curved vein through the center of the leaf.

elements.placement: Main vein beginning at the leaf base and curving gently toward the pointed tip.

steps.name: leaf_secondary_veins
steps.description: Add several curved secondary veins branching from the central leaf vein.

elements.placement: Short veins extending upward from the main vein toward the upper leaf edge.
Short veins extending downward from the main vein toward the lower leaf edge.

steps.name: apple_top_contour
steps.description: Draw the subtle curved contour visible across the upper surface of the apple.

elements.placement: A light curved line following the top surface from the upper-left shoulder toward the stem and continuing slightly onto the right shoulder.

steps.name: apple_left_inner_contour
steps.description: Add the long curved contour line inside the left side of the apple.

elements.placement: Long thin curve following the left outer surface of the apple from upper-left downward and inward.
